result.title: MiSTiQ: MicroScaling Trellis Quantization for Extreme KV Cache Compression
result.summary: Modern large language models (LLMs) increasingly support longer contexts and serve more concurrent requests, increasing both sequence lengths and batch sizes. Both trends increase KV-cache size and memory traffic during inference. KV-cache quantization reduces these costs, with recent approaches using codebook-based vector quantization to achieve extremely low bit widths. However, hardware constraints limit codebook size, and most methods reconstruct the cache in higher-precision floating-point formats for attention, limiting the computational benefits of quantization. To address these limitations, we introduce MiSTiQ, a drop-in replacement for codebook-based vector quantizers that combines trellis-coded storage with microscaling (MX) formats for low-precision computation. We combine trellis quantization with beam search to encode the KV cache over large reconstruction spaces without large codebooks. To support MX computation, we derive MX-Hash functions that generate reconstruction values directly in the target MX element format. These functions use the scale-conditioned marginal distribution of block-normalized Gaussian inputs. On Llama3 and Qwen3, MiSTiQ achieves lower WikiText perplexity and higher GSM8K accuracy than the evaluated baselines across several block-scale formats at approximately 1.25 effective bits per element. With NVFP4, it also achieves the highest LongBench average on both models.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MiSTiQ，用 trellis 编码加 beam search 在有限码本下编码 KV cache，并推导 MX-Hash 使重建值直接落在 microscaling 低精度格式上，从而在约 1.25 比特/元素的极低码率下兼顾困惑度与下游准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文只处理纯文本 LLM 推理的 KV cache 压缩与低精度计算，未涉及视觉或多模态推理状态的内容保留、生成方式、监督或停止决策；虽然「压缩 latent 状态存储」与 LVR 的成本议题表面相关，但原文没有可核查的状态保真度或推理行为线索，故不入选。
